description_sq:
Shesim apartament 2+1+2 te Tirana Trio Towers.
Apartamenti sapo ka perfunduar dhe eshte i pabanuar me pare.
Siperfaqa eshte 105.15m2 dhe eshte e organizuar ne nje dhome ndenje se bashku me kuzhinen, dy dhoma gjumi dhe dy tualete (nje tualet me dritare), nje ballkon dhe korridor shperndares.
Zona eshte e favorshme dhe ju ofron cdo fasilitet te mundshem.
Per me teper informacion ose vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in Tirana Trio Towers. The apartment has just been completed and is uninhabited before. The surface is 105.15m2 and it is organized in a living room together with the kitchen, two bedrooms and two toilets (one toilet with window), a balcony and distribution corridor. The area is favorable and offers you every possible facility. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me!
